correctness.rationale: For fixed integer N>=3 the killed half-line image kernel integrates to S(t)=erf(L/sqrt(4Dt)); renewal reward yields the exact joint stationary mixture with Z_N finite iff N>2. The negative-event kernel F_b(t) is a difference of two erfc values. On t=R^2 s/(4D), S(t)~2L/(R sqrt(pi s)) and F_{aR}(t)/S(t)->exp(-a^2/s); the proof supplies an integrable s^(-N/2) exp(-sum a_i^2/(2s)) bound. Gamma integral produces K_N and the radial exponent N-2, and size-biased conditional age gives U=R^2/(4DA) -> Gamma(N/2-1, rate1), with polynomial moments by strengthened domination. Tail integration proves the exact q<N-2 absolute-moment criterion; conditional independence implies positive cross-covariance for N>=5 only. Independent mpmath exact finite-R event integration for N=3,4,5 and k=1,2 found convergence toward predicted constants (at R=80 ratios ~0.988,0.975,0.963). Finite checks only corroborate the infinite dominated-convergence argument.
